user.title: Connect to Waven
user.description: Paste a Waven API key from your dashboard (Settings → API keys). Wake word, voice activity detection and intent matching stay on this Home Assistant host — only the spoken utterance and the response text are sent to Waven.

data_description.api_key: Begins with wvn_. Stored encrypted in Home Assistant; never written to configuration.yaml.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Waven
reauth_confirm.description: Your Waven API key is no longer valid. Paste a new one.

error.invalid_auth: That API key was rejected. Check it begins with wvn_ and is active.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Waven. Check this host's internet connection.
error.consent_required: This Waven account hasn't accepted the current Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Accept them in the Waven dashboard, then try again.
error.quota_exceeded: This Waven account has reached its usage limit. Check your plan in the Waven dashboard, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This Waven account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That API key belongs to a different Waven account. Re-authentication must use a key for the account this entry was set up with; to switch accounts, remove this entry and add a new one.

init.title: Waven voice settings
init.description: Assign a voice per response type (the hybrid policy). Quick acknowledgements stay snappy with a stock voice; long announcements can use your cloned voice. The daily cap is a hard safety rail — if a stuck microphone burns through it, voice pauses but your automations keep running.

data.audit_enabled: Record a local request audit log

data_description.stt_mode: auto picks per language. accurate = Parakeet (English, best quality). multilingual = Voxtral (en/fr/de/es/it/pt). fast is a legacy option — Moonshine was retired, so it now resolves to Parakeet (identical to accurate); kept only for setups saved before the change.
data_description.daily_cap_minutes: Combined STT + TTS minutes per household per local day. Resets at local midnight.
data_description.retain_audio: When off, Waven deletes each clip as soon as Home Assistant has downloaded it (so an interrupted download loses that one response), and a clip nobody downloads is removed by the hourly cleanup — normally within minutes of that sweep, at worst a little over an hour later. When on, clips stay for 72 hours. Speech-to-text audio from Home Assistant is never stored; gallery voices are unaffected.
